findings.claim: D9 fails the exemption its own amended burn rule states, so §g's conclusion 'neither case is burned' does not follow from the amendment as recorded: D9 changed a threshold and shipped a committed code artifact whose knob was set with a held-out filing's measurements in hand.
findings.evidence: The amendment is a conjunction of four conditions — evals/heldout/README.md:28-29 and ADR-034:588-591: 'authors no case, moves no fixture, changes no threshold and ships no code'. D9 trips two. (a) THRESHOLD: evals/adversarial/ledger-line-refs.json min_refs 9 -> 11 in this PR; the case's own provenance says 'FLOOR RAISED 9 -> 11 on 2026-08-26 (D9, ADR-034)'. (b) CODE + THRESHOLD: tasks/reviews/d9_class_scan.py is a committed 133-line .py added by this PR; :41 reads BODY_MAX = 700 with the comment recording it was set against HELD-OUT intc-2025 body lengths, and :39 reads the heldout fixtures directly. That also falsifies §g:592-594's ground ('there is no artifact in the tree that could have absorbed the labels'). It equally trips the NARROWED D6 H4 sentence at README:351-353. ADR-034:609-611 lists as a falsifier 'a decision that cited a held-out outcome turning out to have carried a threshold or code change after all' — that falsifier fires on this ADR at the moment of writing.
findings.repro: git diff 6b37ffa..HEAD -- evals/adversarial/ledger-line-refs.json | grep -E '^[-+] *"tasks'; sed -n '39,41p' tasks/reviews/d9_class_scan.py; sed -n '28,29p' evals/heldout/README.md
findings.acceptance: Either the amendment's clause distinguishes the thresholds/code it means (e.g. 'no extractor threshold and no src/ change') so D9 plainly falls inside it, or §g and the README adjudicate D9's own min_refs raise and d9_class_scan.py::BODY_MAX explicitly and say why they are not the influence the rule targets. Test: reading only README:26-57, a reader decides whether D9 is exempt and gets the same answer §g publishes.

findings.evidence: ADR-034:261-262 'Two filings hit in more than one bucket' and :316-319 '= 20 bucket entries over 18 distinct fixtures, because gs-2002 and xom-2021 each appear in two buckets'. Scan plus context: ba-2003 @56848 'items 3,135 4,355 1' is a numeric table artifact but ba-2003 is listed only in the cover/footnote bucket; gs-2002 @21527 is a prose cross-reference inside an item body, a THIRD bucket it is not listed in; jpm-2024 @197103 is in the executive-officers body, not a cover sentence; axp-2008 @334794 is the same financial-statements-index shape gs-2002 gets its own bucket for.

findings.acceptance: Either the bucket entries are recounted so the sum matches the fixtures listed under each bucket and the 'two filings' sentence names every multi-bucket fixture; or §c1 drops the entry-count arithmetic and states only the 18-fixture / 39-hit facts plus the one body-heading adjudication.

findings.claim: The amended README contradicts itself: the gs-2002 burn entry still states, present tense and undated, that a documented decision to decline a fix counts as influence and burns — the exact proposition the amendment retracts.
findings.evidence: README:183-184 'the burn rule names "a threshold choice" as burning, and a documented decision to decline a fix is at least as much influence.' Against README:28-30 ('a ruling is not influence') and README:355-359. ADR-034:550-554 leans on this same entry as the precedent that a decline burns 'alone', also unannotated. The D6 H4 entry was amended in place with a dated note; this entry, stating the same superseded proposition, was not — the FOURTH instance of the recurring 'corrected at the cited line, alive elsewhere' defect, this time in the file the amendment edited.
findings.acceptance: README:180-186 carries a dated note that the amendment narrows the ground it states (and whether the gs-2002 burn still stands on another limb, e.g. ADR-013 having shipped code), so no sentence asserts a declined fix burns while :28-30 says a ruling does not.

findings.claim: §g's headline asserts both that the burn rule fires and that neither case is burned, without the 'under the rule as written' qualifier its own body supplies 30 lines later.
findings.evidence: ADR-034:533-534 vs :565-566. Under the rule as amended it does not fire; under the rule as written it does. The bold headline is the sentence a skimming reader keeps.
